purpose: Check one largest source-bound AC1018 SAT-v1 solid with an independent SAT parser and non-OCCT B-rep kernel after exact DXF carrier extraction.

sourceBinding.producerProvenance: Unverified public TrattoCAD sample; no native producer or signed provenance claim.

carrierBinding.extraction: tools/research/decode_dxf_sat1.py reverses the SAT-v1 transform from the exact handle 0x40; the output is checked byte-for-byte against the source payload through the physical-projection selector.

independentRoute.normalization: None; the extracted SAT stream was passed directly to SatDocument::parse and ocs_acis::lift.

validation.result: PASS: ACadRust parses all 3,781 SAT records; OpenCADKernel lifts one body with no surface/curve/reference loss and zero validation flaws.
validation.warnings: The pinned OpenCADStudio build emits existing unexpected-cfg and unused-variable Rust warnings; the probe completed successfully.
validation.repositoryArtifacts: Probe, SAT, and DXF are scratch-only. No DWG/DXF/SAT fixture or external repo edit was added to libdxfrw.

limitations: This validates one exact SAT-v1 carrier originating in a single unauthenticated AC1018 source; it does not qualify a producer family or all seven solids semantically.

The SAT stream is byte-bound to the DWG extraction by the physical projection receipt, but the SAT parser/kernel route does not independently decode the DWG container or verify entity-to-AcDs association.
No native AutoCAD/ODA rewrite, FreeCAD GUI DWG/DXF import, placement/units comparison, source-level expected topology oracle, or platform qualification was performed.
This is selected independent geometry evidence only; strict whole-document output and general 3D support remain open.
claimEffect: Adds one exact-source-bound AC1018 SAT-v1 semantic/kernel check. Does not promote general DWG, DXF, ACIS/ACDS, or 3D support claims.
